Assessment
64-year-old male (DOB 1959-10-14, MRN SYN-4857261) with a 41-pack-year smoking history (1 pack/day for 41 years, quit in 2019) and history of MI/PCI (2022-04, on aspirin 81 mg and prasugrel 10 mg daily), evaluated via e-consult for an 11 mm solid right upper lobe (RUL) posterior segment pulmonary nodule with lobulated margins.

1. Imaging Comparison & Growth Rate Arithmetic:
- Prior outside low-dose screening chest CT (Northshore Imaging Associates, 2022-11-08): 5 mm solid nodule in the RUL posterior segment (classified Lung-RADS 2).
- Current CT angiography chest (2024-05-15, read without outside prior available): 11 mm solid nodule with lobulated margins in the RUL posterior segment; no lymphadenopathy or emphysema.
- Time interval (Δt): 2022-11-08 to 2024-05-15 = 554 days (~18.2 months / 1.52 years).
- Diameter growth: Increased by +6 mm (from D1 = 5 mm to D2 = 11 mm; 120% linear increase; ~0.33 mm/month or ~3.95 mm/year).
- Spherical volume estimation (V = (pi/6) * D^3, where V2/V1 = (D2/D1)^3):
  - V1 (5 mm) = (pi/6) * 5^3 = (pi/6) * 125 ≈ 65.45 mm^3
  - V2 (11 mm) = (pi/6) * 11^3 = (pi/6) * 1331 ≈ 696.91 mm^3
  - Volume ratio (V2/V1) = 1331 / 125 = (11/5)^3 = 2.2^3
